SYNTHETIC STDERR — not captured from a real gemini-cli run.

The host machine uses a generous OAuth quota that absorbs rapid-fire requests
without triggering a 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED error. A real rate-limit failure
would produce stderr output similar to:

  Error: You have exceeded your quota. Please try again later. [HTTP 429]
  Status: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED

Phase 5 error taxonomy will validate the real stderr format against a
free-tier API key with quota limits.
